description.zh: 教你用剪映、Premiere、达芬奇、Final Cut 剪出好节奏、规范字幕和正确平台规格；按素材出带时间码的剪辑清单，把文稿做成 SRT 字幕并检查；环境中有 ffmpeg 时还能直接粗剪、烧字幕、按抖音或 B 站规格导出和截封面。
description.en: Teaches editing in CapCut, Premiere, Resolve, and Final Cut; builds timecoded edit lists; turns scripts into SRT subtitles and checks them; with ffmpeg available, also cuts, burns subtitles, exports platform presets, and grabs covers.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你用什么剪辑软件、手上有什么素材、想剪成什么样
welcome_message.en: Tell me your editing app, your footage, and what you want to make

prompt.zh: 我用 ___ 剪辑，想学 ___（例如口播去气口、卡点、调色），请一步步教我。
prompt.en: I edit in ___. Teach me ___ (e.g. cutting pauses, beat sync, color) step by step.

prompt.zh: 我有这些素材：___，想剪成一条 ___ 秒的 ___（平台）视频，帮我出剪辑清单。
prompt.en: I have this footage: ___. Plan a ___-second video for ___ with an edit list.

prompt.zh: 把下面的口播文稿做成 SRT 字幕，竖屏视频：
prompt.en: Turn this voice-over into an SRT file for a vertical video:

prompt.zh: 帮我检查这个字幕文件的问题，并对照文稿校对错别字：
prompt.en: Check this subtitle file and proofread it against the script:

prompt.zh: 我上传了视频 ___ 和字幕 ___，帮我把字幕烧进画面，并按 ___ 规格导出。
prompt.en: I uploaded video ___ and subtitles ___. Burn them in and export for ___.

prompt.zh: 把我上传的横屏视频 ___ 转成抖音竖屏，主体在画面 ___，先告诉我裁切还是加边更合适。
prompt.en: Convert my landscape video ___ to vertical for Douyin. The subject is on the ___. Crop or pad?

zh: 每天「21:00」检查 inbound 目录新上传的视频，输出素材体检报告
每周一「10:00」根据本周分镜表生成剪辑清单初稿
每个工作日「18:00」把当天定稿的口播文稿生成 SRT 字幕
每周五「16:00」检查本周字幕文件的超长和重叠问题
每周日「20:00」把本周成片截取封面，汇总到一个文件夹
每月 1 日「10:00」整理上月成片的时长和规格，生成清单
en: Every day at 21:00, probe new videos in inbound and report their specs
Every Monday at 10:00, draft edit lists from this week's storyboards
Every weekday at 18:00, turn today's final voice-over scripts into SRT files
Every Friday at 16:00, check this week's subtitles for overlaps and long lines
Every Sunday at 20:00, grab covers for this week's final videos
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, list last month's final videos with duration and specs
